Module_Settings_BruteForce_Tooltip:
Considers every owned module (of the enabled qualities) without needing any stat priorities.
The active Score Mode (ZScore / Combat Power) decides what is ranked/optimized.
Each result still shows both its Combat Power and ZScore.
Note: while OFF, only modules carrying a priority stat are considered (fast); turning it ON widens the candidates to your entire inventory, so the combination count explodes and the search can take minutes. Narrow it with the quality filters or the total-link cutoff (a rough combination count is shown next to the Calculate button).
Module_BruteForce_PriorityNote: Brute Force mode is on. Stat priorities are optional; when set they act as filters (e.g. required Link values).
Module_Settings_ModuleTotalCutoff_Toolti:
Excludes any module whose total Link value (the sum of its stats' Link levels) is at or below this value.
0 = exclude none (keep all modules).
Drops weak modules and shrinks the search space, which also speeds up brute-force runs.
Module_Settings_ComputeBackend_Tooltip:
Which hardware runs the solver.
GPU: evaluates every combination exactly (recommended).
CPU: lightweight beam search; fast but approximate (may miss the true best set).
There is no automatic fallback: if the selected backend fails, the calculation stops with an error.
Module_Settings_GpuUnavailable: GPU initialization failed. Select the CPU backend or check your GPU drivers.
Module_Settings_ResultCache_Tooltip:
After a full GPU search, keeps every combination scoring within the given percent of the 10th-best result.
While your module inventory (and candidate set / set size) is unchanged, later calculations re-score that pool instantly instead of re-enumerating everything.
Requirement-value changes stay exact; scoring changes (priority order, score mode, boosts) are re-scored approximately and flagged in the results.
Module_Settings_CachePct_Tooltip:
Combinations scoring more than this percent below the 10th-best are not kept in the cache pool.
Lower = smaller pool but more full recalculations after setting changes.
Module_Cache_None: No cache yet (built on the next full GPU calculation)
Module_Result_FromCache_Approx: Re-scored from the result cache (scoring settings changed; may be approximate — clear the cache to force a full search)
Module_Settings_ScoringModel_Tooltip:
Switches the ZScore method (no effect in Combat Power mode).
Enhanced: points past 20 are not rewarded (breakpoint-only).
Original: upstream behavior; points past the reached breakpoint are also added.
In both methods a priority left at required Link 0 is still scored by its Link value (weighted by its priority order), so results prefer sets that include it.
Module_Settings_OrderBoostStrength_Toolt:
How strongly higher-priority stats are weighted (ZScore only).
Weight falls off as 1/(position+1)^strength: 0 = every priority equal, higher = top picks dominate.
Module_Settings_LegendaryMul_Tooltip: Score multiplier applied to legendary stats (ZScore only).
Module_Result_CpuFallback: (debug) GPU failed; computed with the CPU beam search (approximate)
Module_Error_SolveFailed_Hint: If the GPU backend failed: reduce the candidate modules (quality filters / total-link cutoff) or switch the Compute Backend to CPU in the Settings tab.
Module_Settings_LinkBoostDesc:
Set the bonus points awarded to a module combination when its Link Level matches or exceeds the given value.
Ex: A module combination that has 'Crit Focus' at +16 would have a Link Level of '5' and get a points boost of {0}.
Module_StatAlreadyAdded: This stat is already added, please select another one.
Module_NoValidCombo: Unable to create a valid combination. Please adjust the Stat Priorities and try again.
Module_CalculateButton_Tooltip:
You can set the number of modules in a combo set.
Click on the "Settings" tab at the top of this window.

The number in parentheses is a rough count of the exhaustive combinations for the current settings (from the candidate modules, before the internal dedup/dominance reduction — an upper bound; shown only for the GPU backend).
Module_ComboCount_Huge: (huge — may take a very long time)
Module_StatFilter_ReqLevel_Tooltip:
The required Link value (lower bound) this stat needs for the combination to be considered.
Leave 0 to allow any Link.

Enter a negative value for an upper-bound CAP (A/E is ignored):
-1 = <=16 / -2 = <=12 / -3 = <=8 / -4 = <=4 / -5 = <=1 / -6 = stat must not appear at all (exclude).
Combos exceeding the cap are rejected (the stat still scores normally up to the cap).
Module_StatFilter_Atleast_Tooltip: In this mode the combo must have ATLEAST this link value.
Module_StatFilter_Exactly_Tooltip: In this mode the combo must have EXACTLY this link value.
Module_Banner_LoadData: Please change line or teleport to load module inventory data.

Settings_BPTimerData_ServerAddress: Server Domain Name or IP Address
Settings_GameCapturePreference_Custom_To:
Use this if your game version is not listed.
Note: You will need to enter the name of the game executable for this to work.
It is located next to a file named 'GameAssembly.dll'.
Settings_WebhookMode_DiscordDeduplicatio: Send to a Discord Webhook after using an External Server to check if the same report was sent already within a short timeframe.
Settings_WebhookMode_DiscordWebhook_Tool: Send directly to a Discord Webhook.
Settings_WebhookMode_CustomUrl_Tooltip: Send directly to a custom URL of your choice.
Settings_WebhookMode_FallbackDiscordDedu: Have an External Server forward to a Discord Webhook after using the External Server to check if the same report was sent already within a short timeframe.
Settings_BPTimerData_AccountId_Tooltip: This is being used to determine what game region is being played on.
Settings_ResetRaidManagerCooldownTracker: Reset Raid Manager Cooldown Tracker Size
Settings_CustomBPSRExecutableName_Desc: The executable file name of the game to listen to. Ex: BPSR_STEAM
Settings_UseDatabaseForEncounterHistory_: When enabled, all encounter data is saved into a local database file (ZDatabase.db) to reduce memory usage and allow viewing between ZDPS sessions. Applies after restarting ZDPS.
Settings_DatabaseEncounterHistoryRetenti: How long to keep previous Encounter History data for. When not set to Keep Forever, expired data is automatically deleted on application close.
Settings_SkipSavingEncountersWithNoComba: When enabled, Encounters that have no combat data (such as damage events) will not be saved to the database.
Settings_LimitEncounterBuffTrackingInOpe: When enabled, buffs are limited to only the latest 100 per entity instead of being limitless. This setting is not retroactive.
Settings_SkipSkillSnapshotSavingInOpenWo:
When enabled, Skill Snapshots are no longer stored whenever a Skill Event occurs. Snapshots makes it possible to view Skill Snapshots (Instances) in the Entity Inspector. They also allow Database Migrations to occur without losing data.
Enabling this setting can help save a lot of memory while in the Open World.
Note: By default your current 'Map' is considered to be the 'Open World' before your first Map Change just after launching ZDPS even if you're not in the Open World.
Settings_AllowEncounterSavingPausingInOp:
When enabled, a button is added to the top of the Main Window that allows the current Encounter to not be saved to the Database.
This is only available while in the Open World and will automatically disable when map changing. Benchmarking and Manual New Encounter creation will be disabled while Paused.
Note: At least one map change is required before the button will appear after starting ZDPS.
Settings_PersistEncounterSavingPauseStat: When enabled, the Encounter Saving Pause state will be remembered even after changing maps. However, the state will not persist between ZDPS sessions.
Settings_MinimalProcessingWhileEncounter: When enabled, while Encounter Saving is Paused, DPS and other metrics will not be calculated. Only the minimum amount of data (Attributes) will be processed.
Settings_NormalizeMeterContributionBars_: When enabled, the bars for each player in a meter will be based on the top player, not the overall contribution.
This means the top player is always considered the '100%%' amount.
Settings_UseShortWidthNumberFormatting_D: When enabled, uses shorter width number formats when values over 1000 would otherwise be shown.
Settings_UseAutomaticWipeDetection_Desc: When enabled, ZDPS will attempt to detect party wipes against bosses and start a new encounter automatically.
Settings_UseLegacyWipeDetection_Desc:
When enabled, uses the old legacy methods for detecting wipes.
You probably want this Disabled.
Settings_UseLegacyWipeDetection_Warning: Note: [Legacy Wipe Detection] is known to not always correctly detect wipes. You likely do not want this old behavior Enabled.
Settings_SkipTeleportStateCheckInAutomat:
When enabled, the 'Teleport' Player State requirement in Automatic Wipe Detection is not performed.
You probably want this Disabled.
Settings_DisableWipeRecalculationOverwri: When enabled, the new Wipe Recalcuation logic will be Disabled and the original method will be used (if 'Use Automatic Wipe Detection' if still Enabled).
Settings_SplitEncountersOnNewPhases_Desc:
When enabled, encounters are automatically split across phase changes. This allows bosses to be split from the rest of a dungeon. It also splits raid boss phases.
This probably should be Enabled.
Settings_DisplayActivePerSecondValuesInM:
When enabled, the Damage, Healing, and Taken Per Second value shown in the Meters will have the 'Active' Per Second value, shown in square brackets, in addition to the normal 'Encounter Per Second' value. This means it is recalculated every second while taking down time and late starts into account instead of ignoring down time and calculating based on when the first damage event in the Encounter was dealt.
Note: Both values are accurate, they are just two different metrics.
Settings_HideEncounterPerSecondValuesInM: When enabled, the normal Encounter Per Second value will not be shown in the meters. Only Active Per Second will be shown.
Settings_IncludeHealEventsOutsideOfComba:
When enabled, Healing events that occur outside of an Active Encounter Combat section will still be included in the calculations.
This means if a player performs healing before a boss is pulled, the Encounter will be considered started before attacks began in the fight.
Settings_ShowClassIconsInMeters_Desc: When enabled, class icons will be shown next to players in the meters.
Settings_ColorClassIconsByRoleType_Desc: When enabled, class icons shown in meters will be colored by their role instead of all being white.
Settings_ShowSkillIconsInDetails_Desc: When enabled, skill icons will be displayed, when possible, in the details panel next to skill names.
Settings_OnlyShowDamageContributorsInMet: When enabled, only players who have dealt damage will show in the DPS meter.
Settings_OnlyShowPartyMembersInMeters_De: When enabled, only players who are in the current party will show in the DPS meter.
Settings_ShowAbilityScoreInMeters_Desc: When enabled, the Ability Score for players will be shown in the meters.
Settings_ShowSeasonStrengthInMeters_Desc: When enabled, the Season Strength for players will be shown in the meters.
Settings_ShowSubProfessionNameInMeters_D: When enabled, allows showing the detected Sub Profession name in the meters. If no Sub Profession is detected, just the base class name is shown. If no base class is found, 'Unknown' is shown.
Settings_ShowPlayerSummonsInNPCTakenMete:
When enabled, Summons (such as Battle Imagine entities or specific skill entities) will be shown in the NPC Taken Meter.
Note: This does not impact any data recording or Entity Inspector data.
Settings_ShowPlayerImaginesInMeters_Desc: When enabled, shows the currently equipped imagines for players in the DPS Meter UI.
Settings_AllowGamepadNavigationInputInZD:
When enabled, gamepad input can navigate and control the ZDPS windows.
Note: Gamepad input may control the windows even without them specifically in focus.
Settings_KeepPastEncounterInMeterUIUntil:
When enabled, the previous Encounter will remain in the Meter UI until damage has been dealt in the current Encounter.
The Meter UI will still swap to the current Encounter on Battle change events (these are generally Map changes).
Settings_ShowChannelLineNumberInStatus_D: When enabled, shows the current Channel Line number in the Status bar of the Main Window.
Settings_ShowCallWipeForEncounterOnMainW: When enabled, adds a button (Skull Icon) to the title bar of the Main Window to 'Call Wipe' for the current Encounter and end it immediately.
Settings_MainWindowOpacity_Desc: How transparent the Main Window is while pinned.
Settings_MainWindowBackgroundOpacity_Des: How transparent the Main Window Background is. Applied even when not pinned.
Settings_CooldownPriorityTrackerWindowOp: How transparent the Cooldown Priority Tracker Window is while pinned.
Settings_EntityCacheViewerWindowOpacity_: How transparent the Entity Cache Viewer Window is while pinned.
Settings_SpawnTrackerWindowOpacity_Desc: How transparent the Spawn Tracker Window is while pinned.
Settings_MeterBarScale_Desc: Scaling for how large the bars in the meter windows should be. 100%% is the default scale.
Settings_SpawnTrackerTextScale_Desc: Scaling for how the text in the Spawn Tracker window should be. 100%% is the default scale.
Settings_SpawnTrackerLineScale_Desc: Scaling for how large the Line (channel) bars in the Spawn Tracker window should be. 100%% is the default scale.
Settings_MeterSettingsTankingShowDeaths_: When enabled, shows a Death counter for each entry in the Tanking Meter.
Settings_MeterSettingsNpcTakenShowHpData: When enabled, adds Current HP, Max HP, and HP Percent to each entry in the NPC Taken Meter.
Settings_MeterSettingsNpcTakenHideMaxHp_: When enabled, removes the Max HP value shown.
Settings_MeterSettingsNpcTakenUseHpMeter: When enabled, shows the current HP Percentage as a Red Bar instead of the Blue Bar that would normally show how much total damage the NPC has taken.
Settings_ResetMainWindowPositionBtn_Desc: Resets the Main Window back to the original default center screen position on your primary monitor.
Settings_ResetMainWindowSizeBtn_Desc: Resets the Main Window back to the original size.
Settings_ResetRaidManagerCooldownTracker: Resets the Raid Manager Cooldown Tracker window back to the original size.
Settings_ResetEntityCacheViewerSizeBtn_D: Resets the Entity Cache Viewer window back to the original size.
Settings_ResetBPTimerSpawnTrackerSizeBtn: Resets the BPTimer Spawn Tracker window back to the original size.
Settings_LowPerformanceMode_Desc: When enabled, will force ZDPS to run at a lower rate, potentially causing stuttering UI when moving windows. Only turn this on if you experience Very High CPU usage from ZDPS.
Settings_FixedFramerate_Desc: Set the UI refresh rate of ZDPS. Setting this below 55hz will likely cause UI stuttering. Changes to this setting are applied and saved in real-time.
Settings_FixedFramerate_Note: Note: Setting this as close to 60hz as possible is recommended for all users.
Settings_EnableGDIBackBufferCopyCompatib: When enabled, Screen Recording programs, like OBS, can perform 'Window Captures' on ZDPS using the (Default) 'BitBlt Capture Method'.
Note: This uses more GPU resources to perform. If this is disabled, 'Desktop Captures' and the 'Window Capture Method' labeled 'Windows 10/11' will still function without issue.
Note: This setting requires a ZDPS restart to fully take effect.
Settings_SaveEncounterReportToFile_Desc: When enabled, writes a report file to the Reports folder located next to ZDPS.
Settings_ReportFileRetentionPolicy_Desc: How long to keep locally saved Report files for. When not set to Keep Forever, expired data is automatically deleted on application close.
Settings_MinimumPlayerCountToCreateRepor: The number of players required in an Encounter to create a report for. This applies to both local saving and Webhook sending.
Settings_AlwaysCreateReportAtDungeonEnd_:
When enabled, Reports are created at the end of a Dungeon if one was not created already.
If this is disabled Reports may not be created if a Dungeon did not end with a boss fight.
Settings_WebhookMode_Desc:
Select the type of Webhook Mode you want to use for sending ZDPS Reports.
'Discord Deduplication' is recommended if other users may be sending the same Encounter Report to the same Discord Channel at the same time to avoid duplicate messages.
Settings_DeduplicationServerURL_Desc: The Discord Deduplication Server URL to prevent duplicate reports with.
Settings_DeduplicationServerURL_Fallback: Note: The server must have Fallback support Enabled for this to work as expected since it will handle sending the Discord request for you.
Settings_WebhookURL_Desc: The Discord Webhook URL to send reports to.
Settings_WebhookURL_Custom_Desc: The Custom URL to send reports to.
Settings_BPTimer_Enabled_Desc: When enabled, allows sending reports back to BPTimer.com.
Settings_BPTimer_Enabled_Note: Note: This setting alone may not enable reports. They must be enabled individually below.
Settings_IncludeOwnCharacterDataInReport: When enabled, your Character UID and Name will be included in the reported data.
Settings_BPTimerFieldBossHPReports_Desc: When enabled, reports Field Boss (and Magical Creature) HP data back to BPTimer.com.
Settings_ReloadDataTablesBtn_Desc: Does not update most existing values - mainly works for data set in new Encounters.
Settings_RestartCaptureBtn_Desc: Turns the MessageManager off and on to resolve issues of stalled data.
Settings_ReloadModuleSaveBtn_Desc: Reloads your module inventory from the 'ModulesSaveData.json' file.
Settings_LogToFile_Desc: When enabled, writes a debug log for ZDPS (ZDPS_log.txt). Applies after restarting ZDPS.
Settings_AggressiveExceptionDebugLogging: When enabled, captures more exception data for when systems break or ZDPS crashes. Applies after restarting ZDPS.

Note: This has a chance to make ZDPS run slower.
Only turn this on when you encounter broken systems or crashes. Reproduce the issue to have a more useful ZDPS_log.txt and then turn off this setting.
Settings_NpcapVeryOutOfDate_Desc: Npcap version is EXTREMELY OUT OF DATE. Please update your Npcap install immediately.
Settings_NpcapOutOfDate_Desc_Format: Npcap version ({0}) is below 1.86. It is strongly recommended to update to this version, or higher, to avoid problems.
Settings_WebhookReportsEnabled_Desc_Form: When enabled, sends an Encounter Report to the given {0} server.
